references.populationDefinition: All four provisional crop windows in each year 2015–2024, zero calendar shift: 40 distinct crop-years, independent of candidate order, eligibility and weights. Bounds fixed for shifts; clip to [0,1].

limitations: Daily precipitation rates are environmental evidence, not field water balance or crop damage.
Dry-spell threshold <1 mm/day and provisional crop windows are illustrative assumptions.
Longer crop windows can admit longer dry runs; normalized swings do not equate biological vulnerability.
No soil, disease, management or previous-crop suitability is established.
Historical windows overlap; no probability or future-climate inference.
